config.reference: Wolberg, W., Mangasarian, O., Street, N., & Street, W. (1993). Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic). UCI Machine Learning Repository.
config.objective: Equal client average of logistic empirical losses plus ridge .05/2||u_i||^2, plus .04 sum_b||DU_b||_N
config.preprocessing: 75% classwise train split; mean/std fitted only on pooled training data; intercept added; every row retained in exactly one client train/test set
config.personalization: Artificial label-skew client partition: each of first four clients has class-conditional weight .8 for malignant and .2 for benign; reversed in last four
config.general_theory_only: Local logistic objectives are coupled across feature blocks; neither common-potential structural theorem nor true sharing labels are asserted
config.oracle_cost: Exact client/block empirical gradient. Counts unequal sample costs separately: one read of every local training example per queried block; each forward logit uses all 31 coordinates
config.diagnostics: Full deterministic mapping every iterate, separately counted/timed and never available to training; test metrics evaluated at final output only
config.timing: Dense single-process NumPy including pilot and EMA arithmetic, excluding diagnostics/data preprocessing; no communication or system speed claim
config.fixed_parameters: One common gamma=delta/(12L) per dataset; no method-specific tuning; both nonuniform strategies pay 12 pilot gradient calls
config.output: First observed instantaneous mapping crossings, not proof of deployable stopping; equal-client held-out loss/error and separately sample-weighted held-out metrics
